{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |sport=Basketball |sex= none |year=2020–21 |team=North Texas Mean Green men's |image=North_Texas_Stacked_Wordmark.png |image_size=150 |conference=Conference USA |short_conf=C-USA |division=West Division |record=18–10 |conf_record=9–5 |CoachRank= |APRank= |head_coach=[[Grant McCasland]] |hc_year=4th |asst_coach1= [[Ross Hodge]] |asst_coach2= Jareem Dowling |asst_coach3= Matt Braeuer |stadium=[[UNT Coliseum]] |champion=[[2021 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] champions |tourney=[[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = second round }} {{2020–21 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Texas]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by fifth-year head coach [[Grant McCasland]], and played their home games at [[UNT Coliseum]] in [[Denton, Texas]] as a member of the West division of [[Conference USA]].{{cite web|title=C-USA Announces Basketball Schedules|url=https://meangreensports.com/news/2020/10/26/mens-basketball-c-usa-announces-basketball-schedules.aspx|publisher=University of North Texas Department of Athletics|accessdate=January 12, 2021|date=October 26, 2020}} In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they finished the season 18–10, 9–5 to finish in third place in the division. They defeated [[2020–21 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Middle Tennessee]], [[2020–21 Old Dominion Monarchs basketball team|Old Dominion]], [[2020–21 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]], and [[2020–21 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] to win the [[2021 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] championship. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 13 seed in the South region. There they upset No. 4-seeded [[2020–21 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]] in the first round for the school’s first ever NCAA tournament victory, before losing to No. 5-seeded [[2020–21 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the second round. == Previous season == The [[2019–20 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team|Mean Green]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 20–11, 14–4 in C-USA play to finish to win the regular season championship.
